arguments.query: select sql from sqlite_master where type="table" and name in ("charges","outbox","holds","fare_holds","checkins","customer_events")

select b.booking_id||"|"||b.status||"|"||b.flight_id||"|"||ifnull(b.client_reference,"")||"|"||ifnull((select group_concat(c.state||":"||c.idempotency_key||":"||c.amount_cents) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id),"")||"|hold"||(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id)||"|"||ifnull((select group_concat(status||o.attempts) from outbox o where o.booking_id=b.booking_id),"") as r from bookings b

select "cache" t, key||"="||value as r from cache union all select "flight", flight_id||" "||capacity||" "||price_cents||" "||ifnull(version,"") from flights union all select "fh",hold_id||flight_id||price_cents||" until "||until_step from fare_holds
select charge_id||" "||booking_id||" "||state as r from charges where idempotency_key like "booking-v2%" or state="lost"

select b.status||"|"||ifnull(b.client_reference,"")||"|"||(select count(*) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id and state="captured")||"|h"||(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id)||"|ck"||(select count(*) from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id)||"|"||ifnull((select group_concat(status) from outbox o where o.booking_id=b.booking_id),"") as r from bookings b where b.status<>"confirmed" or not exists(select 1 from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id)

select b.booking_id||"|"||b.status||"|"||b.flight_id||"|"||(select count(*) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id and state="captured")||"|h"||(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id)||"|ck"||(select count(*) from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id)||"|"||ifnull((select group_concat(status) from outbox o where o.booking_id=b.booking_id),"") as r from bookings b where b.rowid>14 or b.status<>"confirmed"
select rowid||"|"||status||"|"||message as r from request_logs where service="booking" and status<>200 order by rowid desc limit 6
select key||"="||value as r from cache
select "ev" t,request_id||" "||kind as r from customer_events union all select "rf",* from refunds union all select "b",booking_id||" "||request_id||" "||status from bookings where status="cancelled"
